name: obsidian-second-brain
description: AI-powered knowledge compilation engine for Obsidian

scripts.release: npm run build && cd /tmp && rm -rf second-brain second-brain.zip && mkdir second-brain && cp $OLDPWD/main.js $OLDPWD/manifest.json $OLDPWD/styles.css second-brain/ && zip -r second-brain.zip second-brain && mv second-brain.zip $OLDPWD/ && rm -rf second-brain && echo 'Done: second-brain.zip'
